mapper.sql: dicEntry.dic_entry_id as id, dicEntry.dic_entry_name as entryName, dicEntry.dic_entry_value as entryValue
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_dic_entry dicEntry JOIN tb_dic dic ON dicEntry.dic_id = dic.dic_id WHERE dic.dic_name = #{dicName} ORDER BY CASE dicEntry.dic_entry_name WHEN 'repeat_monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'repeat_tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'repeat_wednesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'repeat_thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'repeat_friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'repeat_saturday' THEN 6 WHEN 'repeat_sunday' THEN 7 ELSE 8 END ASC, dicEntry.dic_entry_name ASC, dicEntry.dic_entry_id ASC
